propositions: A rollback-safe, durable pause/resume surface for the reconcile-bridge must preserve old readers, old reconcile vocabulary, and existing workflow behavior while supporting dual-format gate blobs with both legacy and new pause metadata.

Pause operations must block before lock acquisition or ticket mutation, return rc 0 with an exact anchored BRIDGE_PAUSED JSON marker, and prevent commit-and-push in scheduled workflows, while same-reason pauses remain idempotent and conflicting pauses refuse without overwrite.
Resume must delete only the observed ref OID via CAS, recover from corrupt blobs without decoding, and preserve legacy reconcile-check early returns and pre-change gate vocabulary.
Pause provenance must use repository git user.email and first-pause UTC RFC3339 timestamp, with blank-reason, missing-identity, missing-remote, and CAS-movement cases refusing without overwrite.
Corrupt gate blobs must emit clean rc 1 recovery lines without tracebacks, while ordinary rc 0 success, malformed markers, legacy gate rc 4, and old reconcile modes retain existing behavior.

CLI help, generated reference, user guide, exit-code docs, and release notes must expose the preview/sync/pause/resume surface without automatic expiry, new-only blob formats, gate renaming, or old-vocabulary removal.
